verification_level_meaning: The DCC-MCP adapter was imported and booted inside a real Blender 5.1.1 host, and that host performed the build and the render. The job did not issue MCP tools/call requests; see not_claimed.

adapter_boot.root_cause: Blender 5.x runs an isolated interpreter that does not inherit the exported package path, so the adapter is unimportable on a plain host start
adapter_boot.remedy: bootstrap injects the resolved adapter and core package roots into sys.path before importing

hero.independent_method: recomputed from hero_v2.png with Pillow; agrees with the producing run to within 0.15

turntable.independent_note: recomputed on the palettised GIF rather than the source PNG frames, so values sit slightly below the reported range; both prove continuous motion with no still frames

turntable_v2.gif.timing_note: GIF stores delays in 10 ms units; 1000/12 = 83.33 ms is not representable, so the encoder alternates 80 and 90 ms delays to average 83.33 ms. Mean frame rate is exactly 12.00 fps and the cycle is 4.000 s; 8 of 48 frames carry an 80 ms delay and therefore play at 12.5 fps instantaneously.

contact_sheet_v2.jpg.grid_verified_by: column-edge profile on the luminance channel detected gutters at 24, 50, 75 and 99 percent width

showcase_v2.blend.role: source scene; re-rendering it regenerates the hero frame and the 48 turntable frames

not_claimed: MCP tool-level round trip: the scene was built and rendered through Blender's Python API inside the host, not through MCP tools/call requests. The adapter was booted but its tool surface was not exercised by the job that produced these frames.
A sustained interactive MCP session: long-lived background hosts are reaped between agent tool calls in this environment, so the job ran as a single in-process invocation.
Availability of the dcc_mcp_blender_launcher add-on: it was not installed on this host, so automatic MCP server startup on host launch was not exercised.
Cross-host data conservation: this entry involves one host only and makes no claim about transferring the scene to another DCC application.
Geometric or material ground truth: no mesh, vertex, UV or shader values were measured. Every visual claim rests on the reported and independently recomputed luma statistics.
Aesthetic sign-off: composition is expressed only through the measured subject centre, coverage and lit-area fractions, not through human review.
